asOf: AHCB US Historical States & Territories, generalized .01 degree
note: Newberry Library, Atlas of Historical County Boundaries: one shape per version of each state and territory, 3 Sep 1783 to 2000 (the atlas ends in 2000; later versions stay open). Groups follow the atlas's TERR_TYPE: states (and the District of Columbia), organized territories, unorganized federal territory and land not yet organized (purchases, cessions); 'claimed' = the Oregon Country (joint occupation with Britain 1818-1846) and the unsettled boundary north of the Louisiana Purchase; 'independent' = the Vermont Republic and the Republic of Texas, shown for context. The proposed State of Deseret (1849-1851) is left out. Simplified by Orbis.
